name: D1 基本
code: print({k: k * 2 for k in range(3)})

name: D2 len
D3 取键
code:
d = {k: k + 1 for k in range(3)}
print(d[2])

name: D4 for 遍历
code:
for k in {k: k for k in range(3)}:
    print(k)

name: D5 带 if 条件
code: print({k: k for k in range(6) if k % 2 == 0})

name: D7 列表迭代
code:
xs = [1, 2]
print({x: x * 10 for x in xs})

name: D9 老字典字面量不退化
D10 老列表推导式不退化
code:
print([x * x for x in range(4)])
print([[y for y in range(x)] for x in range(3)])

name: D11 字典里是字符串 for
D12 嵌套字典推导式
code: print({k: {j: j for j in range(2)} for k in range(2)})

name: D13 推导式在函数里
